# `aitbc trade get`

Get details of a specific trade.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc trade get [OPTIONS] TRADE_ID
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trade_id` | text | yes | — |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc trade get TRADE_ID
```
